checks.nl_assertion: Agent should modify the items and address as requested.
checks.justification: The agent successfully modified the laptop order (#W3730488) to the requested i5 processor, 256GB SSD, and space grey color. However, the agent never modified the shipping address to the NYC address as requested, and the smartwatch modification (black dial, leather strap) was never completed despite multiple attempts due to persistent 'Variant not found' errors. Only one of three requested changes was fulfilled.
